text: Binary flag over OC_comments (JSON list of counter-argument comments by users other than the OP): 1 if at least one comment cites a specific, actual real-world example to support its counter-argument, i.e. a particular real event, case, person, organization, place, study/statistic/data point, or concrete personal experience; need not be institutional or public, nor externally verified. Output 0 if the list is valid and nonempty but no comment does so (purely abstract reasoning, generic claims, invented/hypothetical scenarios, or vague references without a specific actual case don't count). Empty list gives 0; missing or malformed input gives null. Ignore text that is an OP view-change or delta-award announcement, a post-outcome thank-you/resolution update, or text reporting whether the outcome occurred; generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not such an announcement and stays eligible. List order is irrelevant. Output 0, 1 or null.
